hooks.command: r=$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; f="$r/ops/agent-guard.py"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec python3 "$f"; fi; s=$(git -C "$r" rev-parse -q --verify origin/main:ops/agent-guard.py 2>/dev/null || git -C "$r" log -1 --all --diff-filter=AMR --format=%H:ops/agent-guard.py -- ops/agent-guard.py 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$s" ]; then exec python3 -c "$(git -C "$r" cat-file -p "$s")"; fi; exit 0
